title: Implement Solana offline hourly activity contracts and fail-closed lifecycle fixtures
objective: Implement an offline-only Solana hourly market-activity path: versioned, unexecuted DuneSQL blueprints; UTC 60/90-day profile contracts; deterministic report rendering; and fixed V1-V5 contract tests. Real pool liquidity retention, token-to-pool linkage, first verified external-pool conversion, drawdown/lifecycle survival, and sentiment remain PARK/fail-closed fixtures until an authoritative reproducible source study is approved.
owner_authorization: Offline contracts, unexecuted query blueprints, deterministic fixtures, tests, and local report rendering only. No Dune API/CLI/query execution, credential access, database write or migration, scheduling, delivery, chain-adapter activation, live payload retention, or sentiment collection is authorized.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Dune queries or use Dune API/CLI; do not access keys, cookies, credentials, external APIs, or live payloads.
Do not modify CA creator facts, holder cleaning, creator rules, Dev behavior, wallet-cluster rules, or transaction-wallet quality rules.
Do not modify database migrations, repositories, live-run services, Dune CLI, scheduling, delivery, Lark/Feishu publishing, or CLI entrypoints.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood adapters. Robinhood remains explicitly Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial_coverage; Four.meme remains PARK.

Do not call a valid PumpSwap pool-create event an external listing, external pool conversion, migration, graduation, or token-level linkage. Do not calculate real liquidity retention, real conversion/graduation, real drawdown/survival, or sentiment values.
Do not present address observations as people, buyers, demand, wallet quality, or a token-buy signal; time concentration is not holder, wallet, or entity concentration.
